channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Vietnam reports over 18,000 traffic accident emergencies in 5 days of Tet
item.description: Vietnam recorded 18,255 emergency cases linked to traffic accidents and 123 suspected traffic-related deaths during the first five days of the 2026 Lunar New Year (Tet) holiday from February 14 to February 19, the Ministry of Health said in a preliminary report.

item.title: Vietnam’s General Secretary To Lam meets with foreign leaders on sidelines of Board of Peace meeting
item.description: General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam To Lam met with the Presidents of Indonesia, Uzbekistan, Azerbaijan and Kazakhstan; the Prime Ministers of Cambodia, Armenia, Hungary and Pakistan; and the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Czech Republic, on the sidelines of the inaugural meeting of the Gaza Board of Peace in Washington D.C. on Thursday morning (local time).

item.title: Lotte Entertainment Vietnam CEO kneels, bows at Hanoi event to seek support for ‘Mui Pho’
item.description: The chief executive of Lotte Entertainment Vietnam knelt and bowed three times before an audience during a cinetour event in Hanoi for the 2026 Lunar New Year (Tet) film ‘Mui Pho,’ urging viewers to support the movie as it posts the lowest box office revenue among this year’s four Vietnamese Tet releases.

item.title: Johnson & Johnson explores $20 billion sale of orthopedics unit, source says
item.description: Johnson & Johnson is preparing a potential sale of its orthopedics unit, in a deal that could top $20 billion, with the company eyeing private equity firms as the most likely buyers, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Thursday.

item.title: Jewelry snatcher arrested after woman dies in Vietnam’s Can Tho
item.description: Police in Can Tho City, southern Vietnam said on Thursday they had arrested a 29-year-old man for allegedly snatching jewelry from a woman, causing her to lose control of her motorbike and die in a collision.

item.title: Beaches packed, hotels fully booked in Vung Tau on third day of Lunar New Year
item.description: Nearly 40,000 visitors flocked to Vung Tau tourist hub in Ho Chi Minh City on Thursday (the third day of the 2026 Lunar New Year holiday), with many hotels reporting full occupancy and traffic congestion occurring on several major roads.

item.title: Tesla cuts price of Cybertruck model Cyberbeast in US
item.description: Tesla has reduced the price of Cyberbeast, its most-expensive Cybertruck pickup truck model, to $99,990 from $114,990 in the United States, according to pricing information on the automaker's website on Thursday.

item.title: Google, Shopee-owner Sea to develop AI tools for e-commerce, gaming
item.description: Alphabet Inc's Google and Southeast Asian technology conglomerate Sea Ltd announced a new tie-up on Thursday that will develop artificial intelligence tools for Sea's e-commerce and gaming products.

item.title: Tourist boat anchored off Vietnam's Phu Quoc suddenly catches fire, spreads to fish raft
item.description: A tourist boat anchored off Phu Quoc Special Zone in An Giang Province, southern Vietnam suddenly caught fire in the early hours of Wednesday, with flames later spreading to a nearby fish raft, causing an estimated VND1.9 billion (US$73,161) in damage.
